description: Store a value in relay-side memory. Values are encrypted by the relay with a key it derives from this identity's API key, so the relay can read them while it serves a request. They are not encrypted on this machine. Acts as the identity in the local credential store.

key.description: Key name (1-256 characters, same character set)

ttl.description: Time to live in seconds (omit for no expiry)

value.description: Value to store (string, number, boolean or JSON object)

name: agent_memory_set
